builds.name: Reference: Ranked mid core
builds.goal: Reference for Hwei: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ mid players use most (3,194 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 55.7% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A ranged combination mage who pairs distinct damaging spells for passive explosions and selects control or ally utility for the situation. He trades mobility for broad zone control. The current mid provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Blackfire Torch → Liandry's Torment → Shadowflame. Arcane Comet keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Sorcerer's Shoes, Rabadon's Deathcap, Zhonya's Hourglass.
builds.summary: The proven mid baseline: Blackfire Torch → Liandry's Torment → Shadowflame, with Arcane Comet.
testPlan: Play it in mid as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Blackfire Torch → Liandry's Torment → Shadowflame) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 55.7% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Blackfire Torch → Liandry's Torment → Shadowflame.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.

kitEvidence.formula:
Hwei launches a vision of pure despair that sticks to an enemy champion for [3] seconds. The vision expands over time applying a Slow to enemies for [10]% stacking every 0.25 seconds, and dealing [10 / 20 / 30 + (0.05) × AP] magic damage per second.

Upon completion, the vision shatters, dealing [200 / 325 / 450 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.

Hwei's damaging Abilities against enemy champions mark them for [4] seconds.

Hitting marked enemies with a second damaging Ability creates an explosion underneath them dealing [characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 285; raw flags preserved) + (0.35) × AP] magic damage to all enemies in range.

builds.name: Serenity damage medic
builds.summary: Test serenity damage medic against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test serenity damage medic against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Serenity WW grants an AP-scaled ally shield over time; Helia stores charges from champion damage, then shielding consumes them as healing. EQ/EW/EE immobilization fits Mandate's current vulnerability text, while WE restores mana for damage-to-shield cycles.
testPlan: Required state: An ally remains in WW and Hwei lands distinct damaging spells.
Measure Helia charge spending and allied shielding per WW cast.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Weak burst and shielding reduction make the utility investment poor.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: WE's self mana restoration is not an allied heal; Mandate no longer follows every slow in this catalog.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Echoes of Helia, Moonstone Renewer, Ardent Censer, Dawncore, Imperial Mandate, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Record the chosen utility/control spell and actual zone time; no single generic combo represents every spellbook situation. Start with the early core (Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
